integrity: The proof reduces ordinary color refinement exactly to a weighted level path and separates the core-refinement and defect-propagation clocks. A standalone checker verifies 2,500 broad quotient cases plus 32 full-graph depth/orbit cases.
scientific limitations: Only ordinary one-dimensional color refinement from the uniform coloring is treated.
Both perfect halves have the same branching factor d>=2; generalized Bethe trees and unequal branching factors are not covered.
The full-graph checker covers small parameters while the weighted quotient is checked much more broadly; the infinite theorem rests on the proof.
No independent literature audit has been performed.
title: Exact color-refinement depth of asymmetric double Bethe trees
